question: Related Questions Q. If a person gives his property [2 houses] by Bakhshish to his grandson [pota] directly without giving his 2 sons, is it valid accordingly to Shariah 2154 views Q. My late father didn’t make any will, now we have to distribute the assets among my mother, sister (married), younger brother and I (married). 1671 views Q. Can a person make will for his daughters during his life time? 2261 views Q. ALLOCATION OF SHARES OF DECEASED LADY 1962 views Q. My intention is to distribute my share of land as per Islamic law 1698 views Q. How can a property be divided between 2 sons and one daughter? 10403 views Q. The situation is: my grandfather gave my father agricultural land and village property.my father is the only son and has five sisters. The peoperty is 6 acres of land and a house. As per village traditions, my grand father did not give any share to his daughters. My grand father died in 2000 and my father becomes owner of property and he added 10 more acres to the property from his earnings. Property is now being transferred to me as sole male heir, i have two sisters as well. Now I don't want to do the same and infact I wish to reverse what my grand father and the my father has done. I wish to give my phuphoos (my father's sisters their share which should have been given by my grand father) and to my sisters as per shariah as I don't want to take this burdon to next world. 1.my mother is dead I have two sisters. 2.My father has five sisters out of which one has died. 3.my grand mother is alive but not in senses and bed ridden (very ill) My question is: 1.how can I rightfully do this? give my phuphoos (my father's sisters) and then remaining among myself and my sisters. 2.Am I obligated to correct my grandfather's wrong act of not giving share to daughters? 2.my grandfather died in 2000 so the price of land at that time will be used to do shares? Can we use price of property in year 2000 as that was the time for doing the sahres. I am planning to sell everything and then do the shares. Assume price of one acre as 1,000,000 in 2007 price of one acre in year 2000 was 500,000. grand father left 6 acres father added 10 more Thanks in advance for guidence. 2057 views Q. A father during his lifetime gifted his daughter a house (which was then legally transferred from his name) and also said and wrote that 30 thousand pounds of the value of another property, which he owned, is now the property of the daughter. This gift was granted because of the daughter?s khidmat of the father and his wife, due to which the daughter never married and stayed single. Now, in a twist of events the father and daughter once had an argument and during the exchange the daughter said, ?I don?t need anything from you, no house no money? referring to the gifts the father had granted her. Now the question is, by saying these words, does it have any effect of her ownership of the house or the 30 thousand pound property value, which she previously received from the father. May Allah reward you. 2386 views Q. assalamwalekum, respected n knowlegeable ulema's, this is to ask my mothers right to her fathers property. my grand father (nana/mothers father ) were 2 brothers n 5 sisters. he married twice had 3 kids from the first wife who died long ago but the second wife doesnt have any kids and is a widow. my mother is the youngest of 2 brothers .one died in 2000 in U.K he was a doctor there he left behind his wife and 4 sons all residing in the UK. my mothers elder brother is a divorcee with no kids and still alive. my grand father left behind vast immovable and movable property in form of residences farms money cattles land holdings fire arms etc etc. without any will . ill be highly obliged if u instruct us in the division of my mothers ancestral property which was in the name of my grand father or earned by him . plz give us the division details according to the sharia law as well as indian law for muslims if any as such present. helping us in this matter will solve our long standing problems in our family. thanking you with warm regards! 1471 views Q. My wife owns the house we live in. She wants to will the house to me. We have two sons but she wants me to inherit the entire property after her death. Can she make a will and do so? 1760 views Q. Division of Property 1864 views Q. Inheritance 1632 views Q. How to distribute property during lifetime? 2494 views Q. Inheritance 1858 views Q. My question that there are three brothers of one mother.Their mother has not any brother & Sister. Their Grand father Nana)i.e. father of their mother registered his property in the name of two brother who served him.There is any share of third brother who not served his Nana in the light of Islam.While their mother, Nana & Nani have expired. 1961 views
answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 44448 Country: India Title: MONEY DISTRIBUTION Question: My name is Dr M N Hoda and I have some questions regarding money distribution of my mother. She is expire and left the Rs (INR) 1244400. So I want to know from law of Islam (Shariah) about money distribution. I am three brothers (all are available) and two sisters (all are available) and the amount of distribution is Rs (INR) 1244400. So how it shall be distributed? Please solve our problem and send a fatwa (in a letter form) on my address. I am very thankful to you. Answer ID: 44448 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 551/L=226/TL=1434) In the case mentioned above, if at the time of your mother’s death none among your father, nana, nani was alive then the property of your mother shall be divided into 8 shares, after due rights preceding inheritance. Out of the total, 2-2 shares shall go to each brother and 1-1 share to each sister. And the money shall be divided in a way that each brother shall get Rs 311100 and each sister shall get Rs 155550. The detail of division is as follows: Details: Sons: 3x02 = 06 (311100x3=933300) Daughters: 2x01 = 02 (155550x2=311100) Total: 8 (1244400) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
